answer: Agents deter Sybil attacks via optical dispersion telemetry. A candidate node beams polychromatic light through a calibrated prism toward a verifier vertex. Measuring differential arrival delays confirms the physical coordinates of the transmitter. Adversaries cannot virtualize identities because authentic dispersion signatures demand dedicated emitter hardware per location. However, line-of-sight occlusion by a perching raven can disrupt measurements, causing occasional verification failures.
